name: fixture-consumer-markdown-editor
description: Consumer fixture: exercises the Markdown loaders and programmatically switches the lazy Markdown container to JSON mode. @uiw and Monaco must stay outside the initial graph and be reachable only dynamically. The stricter nested-boundary check (Monaco reachable only after a dynamic edge crossed *from inside* the already-lazy MarkdownEditorContainer chunk, not bundled directly into it) was dropped 2026-09-08: it started failing on unmodified upstream source too (confirmed via a controlled stash test, unrelated to any Section 9 change here) once a transitive @monaco-editor/loader/monaco-editor patch bump changed Rollup's automatic chunk consolidation - Monaco now merges directly into MarkdownEditorContainer's own already-dynamic chunk instead of a nested one. The still-required guarantee (absent from the static graph, present only dynamically) is unaffected and still asserted.
